label: Square Jeans Pocket
description: The square jeans pocket is the classic Western five-pocket front opening: a near-vertical, squared-off curve reinforced with rivets and topstitching. It is the most casual and rugged front-pocket style, signalling denim and workwear heritage rather than tailoring. The squared shape sits tight to the body and is built for durability.
